original_submission.content:
import csv
rows = list(csv.reader(open('storage/shared/atlas/overlays/stability_augmented.csv')))[1:]
entropy_proxy = 0.0  # From #17: perfect linearity as low entropy
with open('storage/shared/atlas/overlays/stability_refit.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['w', 'level', 'ethos_delta', 'stability', 'entropy_proxy'])
    for r in rows:
        writer.writerow(r + [float(r[3]), entropy_proxy])
print('Refit CSV generated.')
